comparison.objective: Seat a deep-well plate in a spring-tab deck nest using the plate to retract the tab versus tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Contact-guided insertion against a compliant latch versus hex-key alignment, counterholding, collar adjustment, locking, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Plate seating with spring-tab engagement is implied; seating and damage tolerances are missing. Candidate requires two safe, repeatable locked stops.
comparison.reason: Although both involve contact and spring behavior, the mechanisms and tested outcomes are materially different.
